benchmark_container_scope: Docker Desktop Linux/aarch64 VM; affinity pins VM vCPUs, not physical Apple cores; Mac host load not constrained. Sequential runs; no simultaneous builds/tests in final timing runs. Not comparable to the published native AMD benchmarks.
compressor_body_artifact: profiles/prepared-1-room.html.gz is a full response from a different origin; the exact compressor input is compressor-room.html.gz
compressor_commands: For rep=1..5: BENCH_REVERSE=$((rep%2)) CAMPFIRE_BENCH_BODY=/src/.cache/room.body GOMAXPROCS=1 taskset -c 0 go test -C bench/compression -run ^$ -bench . -benchmem -benchtime=1s -count=1; then CAMPFIRE_BENCH_BODY=/src/.cache/room.body GOMAXPROCS=1 taskset -c 0 go test ./internal/front -run ^$ -bench BenchmarkPreparedGzip -benchmem -benchtime=1s -count=5
docker_recipe:
FROM golang:1.27.1
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libvips-dev libzstd-dev zstd ffmpeg python3 util-linux && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /src
